description: Free. Starts background extraction for up to 20 parts at once, e.g. a BOM, so they are ready before you read them. Returns immediately with each part's status. A datasheet nobody has read before usually takes 1-3 minutes, 5 or more for a large one or a busy queue. These are estimates, not deadlines. Poll check_extraction_status (free). A part without a known datasheet comes back 'queued' while we look for its PDF, and reads 'resolving' until the search ends; only then is 'no_source' final: check the part number, or attach the PDF with request_datasheet_upload (org-private). The Free plan has a daily cap on new datasheets ('trial_limit'). MPNs or LCSC numbers only; resolve value-only BOM rows with search_parts first. Example: prefetch_datasheets(['TPS54302', 'ADS1115', 'LP5907']) datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

part_numbers.description: 1-20 parts. Specific manufacturer part number (MPN) or LCSC number (e.g. 'TPS54302DDCR', 'C2837938'). Not a value ('100nF'), description or reference designator ('R1').
